scope: Bounded current-view resource gather occupancy for the accepted R7-003 route

lwbridgeReference.result: The recovered resource row chooses Gathering versus Idle from gatherMarchUuid/gatherUid presence.

locators: gatherUid:string and gatherAllianceId:string recorded by LWB-R6-048
currentManagedArtifact.result: The current managed client owns both gather identifiers on ResPointInfo and exposes a typed resource-point lookup.

implementation.result: The bounded probe marks occupancy known only when both recovered fields exist and are readable; it derives occupied only from a nonempty/nonzero gather identifier.
The importer preserves a source-backed boolean only when the probe supplies both the known marker and occupied value; older/incomplete captures remain unknown.
Bounded rows use rebuildGatherOccupied only when rebuildGatherOccupancyKnown is true; false stays unknown and ordinary recovered rows keep the original formatter.

validation.deterministicDesktop: PASS: six deterministic groups true; failures=[]; selected installation diagnostic valid; game and launcher stopped before live proof

supersededAttempt.limit: Preserved as incomplete evidence: it reported gatherOccupancyKnown=true but did not serialize gatherOccupied=false, so it is not accepted for occupancy-state semantics.

restriction.result: Automatic review rejected the operation because safety status could not be determined. It was not repeated as a bundle; narrower exact line reads were permitted and supplied the needed evidence.

limits: The final live observations prove the current selected point is idle; no live point with a nonempty gather identifier was observed, so the true/Gathering branch is recovered-static plus offline-tested rather than LIVE-PROVEN.
Resource-name mapping remains unknown; resourceTypeId=14 is not promoted to an LWBridge resourceNameKey.
The backend two-read proof does not create or verify the normal Map Data window, so PM12-D screenshot/interaction proof remains open.
This route does not establish persistent bridge readiness, original pipe grammar, full-world scanning, or different Normal/Fast scan behavior; probeOnlineAfterSecond remains false.

implementationImpact.enabled: For bounded current-view resource rows from probe version 2, source-backed idle/gather occupancy may flow into the existing recovered Idle/Gathering renderer when both gather fields are readable.
implementationImpact.stillGated: Normal-window visual acceptance, live Gathering observation, resourceNameKey mapping, persistent bridge readiness, broader scan lifecycle and unsupported map kinds.
